purpose: Manual source research for validating and extending freely reusable neighborhood geometry.

records.name: Sestakert

sources.role: Actual polygon geometry; the raw OSM snapshot and ODbL attribution are retained separately.
Independent neighborhood description listing the boundary streets, not merely a redevelopment action area.
Municipal neighborhood map; Sestakert is listed as number 48.
Reproduced municipal resolutions 92/2004 and 282/2005 link Sestakert to city-planning district 19.

remainingChecks: Cross-check the actual polygon against every listed boundary street and the municipal map.
Inspect boundary junctions and sample addresses on both sides of each boundary street.
Review neighboring polygons for gaps and overlaps before automatic address assignment.
